claim: S-1 shows $16.3B revenue in H1 2026 (vs $4.6B for all 2025), net loss $80.7B through June (mostly accounting charges), 2025 net loss $42B; about one-fifth of revenue from two customers; $9B spent on AI infrastructure in H1 2026 vs $7.3B in 2025.
quote: generated $16.3 billion in revenue in the six-month period that ended in June

claim: Per Yahoo Finance live blog: Q2 2026 revenue $11.6B (Q1 $4.7B); Q2 operating income $974M after $1.7B Q1 operating loss; compute costs $5.6B in Q2 vs $3.4B in Q1; headcount about 5,300 as of Sept 30.

Yahoo says Anthropic plans to spend upward of $430B on locked-in cloud compute deals, as much as $637B including cancellable and smaller deals. claim: Anthropic generated 48% of H1 2026 revenue through cloud marketplace sales from Google, Amazon and Microsoft, per Yahoo coverage cited by MarketAlleys.

claim: April 7, 2026: Anthropic signed a multi-gigawatt TPU deal with Google and Broadcom, capacity coming online from 2027; dollar amount not stated in that article. A Broadcom filing reportedly cites about 3.5 GW starting 2027.

claim: As of Sept 20, no federal statute preempts state AI laws. 'Great American AI Act' is a House discussion draft (released June 4) proposing a 3-year preemption of state laws on AI model development, stalled since June. EO 14365 (Dec 11, 2025) directs a DOJ task force to challenge state AI laws. Speaker Johnson said Congress shouldn't 'panic' into emergency AI regulation.
quote: bipartisan 'Great American AI Act' preemption draft has stalled since June
